standard-dialogue-without-book-o-piracy.npc: Arr? Be ye wantin' te go on account with our gang o' fillibusters?
The powder monkey be takin' a caulk after gettin' rowdy on bumboo, so there be plenty of room for ye.

standard-dialogue-without-book-o-piracy.player: I'll just be over here if you need me.

standard-dialogue-with-book-o-piracy.npc: Hello stranger, you come for a drink?

standard-dialogue-with-book-o-piracy.player: What sort of drinks do you have?

standard-dialogue-with-book-o-piracy.npc: We got some cold beers, some warm stews and some 'rum'.
Yes! There was some sorta problem at the brewery, but they got it all sorted out now.
